name: Honda CB175 / CL175
engine: 174 cc air-cooled SOHC parallel twin, two carbs
intro: A small Honda twin that's simple to learn on. The cam runs straight in the head, so oil care matters.

add.title: Check the cam journals and head
add.instructions: With the cam out, check the journals and the bearing surfaces in the head for scoring.
add.reason: The cams run directly in the head on these small twins, so neglected oil changes show up here.

H: Change the oil often, around every 1,000 miles as Honda said. The cam has no separate bearings.
F: Most lighting faults trace back to the connectors inside the headlight shell.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Cam and head wear
known.what: Cams run in the head and suffer from old oil.
